name: Jeskai Elders
description: The older leaders of the Jeskai who appointed Narset khan and who accept the claim that the orcs were lying.

timeline.summary: Narset recalls growing up an outsider who retreated into imaginary worlds, then undertaking the Way of the Wandering Warrior and being appointed khan by the elders.
timeline.quote: my counsel was sought out by many regarding these matters, until the elders saw to appoint me the khan of the Jeskai.

timeline.summary: The imprisoned orcs all tell the same story, but the elders accept that they are lying; Narset concludes Tarkir is sick with war.
